case: formal project authorizer admission probe (no LINE GUI, no Save All, no download)
case_note: This was an admission probe, not a read-only preflight as a whole. The probe covered Authorizer operations only: native_authorize is genuinely read-only (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:668-671 states it does not initialize the GUI ledger, does not take owner consent and does not observe LINE), but gui_initialize belongs to the PROJECT_MUTATING set (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:55) and inspect --include_gui_ledger_status authorizes internally with gui_observe (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:693), which is also PROJECT_MUTATING. In this run both mutating-capable operations were refused before reading their payload, so no ledger, receipt, state entry or GUI observation was written. The per-invocation read_only field below states this per operation; the run as a whole must not be described as a read-only preflight.

invocations.side_effects: none (read-only authority check; does not initialize ledger, does not observe LINE, does not take owner consent; src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:668-671)

refused before any ledger write; receipt path untouched. read_only=false because gui_initialize belongs to the PROJECT_MUTATING set (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:55) and therefore has write potential (it initializes the GUI ledger and its gui-ledger-initialization.json receipt); it must not be reused as a read-only probe.

refused before any write. read_only=false because inspect --include_gui_ledger_status authorizes internally with gui_observe (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:693), and gui_observe belongs to the PROJECT_MUTATING set (src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:55) because it can append GUI observation entries to the ledger.
none (read-only state snapshot only; does NOT prove grant admission, is NOT a Save All authorization and does NOT establish authority over the LINE GUI)
invocations.note: Reads state only. A zero exit here is not grant admission, is not a Save All authorization and does not establish that any GUI operation would be admitted.

repeat_probe_note: Invocation 13 (gui_initialize re-run with the correct payload, issued to clear up evidence) and invocation 14 (native_authorize re-run) are unnecessary duplicate calls of operations that had already been refused with the identical PROJECT_CONTRACT_DRIFT code. Stopping at the first refusal was the correct behaviour in this run, but it must not be adopted as the standing procedure: the probe cost two extra invocations without producing any new discriminating information. For the next round only a SINGLE read-only native_authorize admission probe is permitted; no gui_initialize probe and no inspect --include_gui_ledger_status probe may be issued, because both are PROJECT_MUTATING and must never be used as read-only probes.
